idea-plugin.name: srl
idea-plugin.description:
Language support for srl templates: inline diagnostics, completion, hover, navigation, references, quick fixes, semantic highlighting, outlines, and srl live templates. Uses the project's own @srljs/cli so editor behavior matches the installed runtime.

Rename over LSP arrives in the platform in 2026.1.1. On 2026.1 every other feature listed here works and rename stays with WebStorm's own JavaScript refactoring.
